title: Integration of the Oura Ring Into Post-Discharge Care After Acute Kidney Injury
official: Integration of the Oura Ring Into Post-Discharge Care After Acute Kidney Injury
summary:
This study will explore whether health data collected by the Oura Ring, such as heart rate, sleep, and activity, are related to hospital readmissions and other health outcomes in people recovering from acute kidney injury (AKI), a sudden decline in kidney function.

Participants will wear an Oura Ring during the study to collect health data. Researchers will use medical records and surveys to track hospital readmissions, recurrent AKI, changes in kidney function, cardiovascular events, and death.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged ≥18 years.
* Hospitalized with Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) Stage 2 or 3 AKI during admission.
* Ability to provide informed consent.
* Willing to comply with study procedures, including daily Oura Ring use.
* Access to a smartphone compatible with the Oura App and willingness to use an Oura Ring provided study device.
* Access to Wi-Fi connection

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-English or Spanish-speaking participants
* End-stage kidney disease (ESKD) or chronic dialysis.
* Previous kidney transplant recipient.
* Non-kidney end-organ failure (e.g., Class IV heart failure, Model for End Stage Liver Disease (MELD) \>30 with hepatorenal syndrome, end-stage pulmonary disease).
* Active malignancy with ongoing chemotherapy or radiotherapy.
* Life expectancy \<6 months or palliative care.
* Pregnancy.
* Vulnerable populations (e.g., incarcerated, cognitive impaired, or institutionalized individuals)
* Cardiac dysautonomia (e.g., Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome (POTS), atrial fibrillation, sick sinus syndrome).
* Severe dermatological conditions (e.g., Raynaud's syndrome, scleroderma) preventing ring wear.
* Known allergies or previous reaction to titanium or medical-grade plastic.
* Implanted device (e.g., cardiac pacemaker, deep brain stimulator, etc.).
* Unable to synchronize Oura ring with cell phone software
* Any condition where wearing the Oura Ring is deemed unsafe, determined by the PI.
* Android IOS 9 or lower, Apple IOS 15 or earlier
